statements.t: We estimate that additional costs directly related to the transaction during the second half of fiscal 2027 will total $20.0 million to $25.0 million.
In the third quarter of fiscal 2027, we will derecognize SpinCo’s net assets against shareholders’ equity.
As a result of this distribution, no gain or loss will be recognized in our consolidated statement of operations.
We will report the Performance Technologies business as a discontinued operation starting with the third quarter of fiscal 2027.
We recently announced that, subject to shareholder approval and the completion of other regulatory steps, we intend to change the name of our company to Modexus Solutions, Inc.

Our common stock will continue to trade on the New York Stock Exchange under our current ticker symbol, “MOD.” As part of the spin-off transaction, Gentherm acquired the Modine brand, domains, and trademarks and the Performance Technologies business will continue to go to market as Modine.
We will continue using the Modine brand in certain businesses (the Heat Transfer Solutions and HVAC Technologies businesses within our Commercial HVAC segment) under a license with Gentherm.
We expect to sell the facility by the end of calendar 2026.

We expect that income tax detriments related to non-deductible compensation during the remainder of fiscal 2027 will be higher than the comparable prior-year period and will largely offset the income tax benefits related to stock-based compensation awards recorded during the first quarter of fiscal 2027.
As a result, we do not expect the tax benefits related to stock-based compensation will significantly impact our full-year fiscal 2027 effective tax rate.
We expect the sale of this facility will close by the end of calendar 2026.
We believe our sources of liquidity will provide sufficient cash flow to adequately cover our funding needs on both a short-term and long-term basis.
We expect to remain in compliance with our debt covenants during the remainder of fiscal 2027 and beyond.

statements.t: We are confident in our higher revenue outlook for our core business following the successful spin-off of Performance Technologies and remain well-equipped to drive long-term sustainable growth.”

“We are updating our Fiscal 2027 financial outlook to reflect the higher expectations for our core businesses and the successful spin-off of the Performance Technologies business,” said Modine President and Chief Executive Officer, Neil D.
“Starting in the third fiscal quarter, the historical results for Performance Technologies will be reported as discontinued operations, and we have revised our continuing outlook accordingly.
We expect revenues to increase 50 to 55 percent from the prior year, excluding Performance Technologies from both periods.

Additionally, we expect full-year adjusted EBITDA for our continuing business to be $470 to $500 million, representing a growth rate in excess of 50 percent from the prior year, excluding Performance Technologies from both periods.
In addition, I am looking forward to sharing our longer term revenue and earnings targets during our upcoming Analyst and Investor Day on November 18.”
The Company’s fiscal 2027 guidance excludes the results of the Performance Technologies business, which will be reported as a discontinued operation starting for the third quarter of fiscal 2027.

The fiscal 2027 guidance includes the following estimates for the Company’s remaining businesses (excluding Performance Technologies): interest expense of approximately $26 to $30 million; a provision for income taxes of approximately $95 to $105 million; and depreciation and amortization expense of approximately $56 to $61 million.

In connection with the Reverse Morris Trust transaction with Gentherm, the Company expects to incur approximately $20 to $25 million of additional costs during the second half of fiscal 2027, primarily for transaction advisory, legal, accounting, tax and other professional services.
